assessments.reasoning: LaTeX3 Project copyright notice in the revision-matched 1.0 publisher original, acquisition 193d23e5ba2c4ccf97875a15653fcc63. Header bytes [0,249), SHA-256 3335574f00dc794769118ab1bf92f7d465f157d79af0825c297a6f6ad0476ab9, contain the grant and qualifier together.

challenge.method: Read the adjoining prohibition on modification and the preamble’s permission to use parts as a model for a different license. Tested whether either changes the object of the grant.
challenge.results: The prohibition concerns modifying the document. The model-license passage concerns an author’s own license. Neither extends the verbatim-copy finding to an edited or partial representation.

limitations: The grant concerns verbatim copies of the license document. The header alone establishes no source-distribution condition for a Program.
reasoning: The 1.0 copyright header expressly permits everyone to “copy and distribute verbatim copies of this license document.”
